key_insight: Verification is introduced as a new scaling axis for LLMs: instead of only generating solutions, the model estimates solution correctness with fine-grained, continuous scores.
engineering_relevance: This enables more reliable ranking, progress tracking, and dense feedback for agentic systems, improving selection and training efficiency without extra verifier training.
method: Compute verification scores from the expectation over scoring-token logits rather than a single discrete judge output.
Scale verification through finer score granularity, repeated evaluation, and criteria decomposition to improve calibration and accuracy.
Use continuous verifier scores for cost-efficient candidate ranking, task-progress estimation, and dense RL feedback.
evidence_signal: The framework reports state-of-the-art results on Terminal-Bench V2 (86.5%), SWE-Bench Verified (78.2%), RoboRewardBench (87.4%), and MedAgentBench (73.3%).
watch_item: Performance depends on careful scoring-token design and decomposition choices, and continuous scoring may add implementation complexity in deployed agent loops.
